observed.caption: A pond covered with lily pads and yellow flowers in an urban park with a city skyline and people along the grassy edge under an overcast sky.
observed.description: In the foreground a large pond is densely covered with green lily pads and small yellow flowers with patches of open water reflecting tall buildings. A strip of green grass borders the pond on the right and middle where numerous small figures of people are standing, walking and sitting. Two low green pedestrian bridges span a narrow channel of the pond in the middle distance. Behind the park a cluster of high-rise buildings with glass facades rises against a cloudy gray sky, including a prominent brown glass tower on the right and a blue glass twin-peaked tower near the center. Palm trees and other trees line the left and middle background, and a white car is parked on the grass on the right. The sky is overcast with diffuse daylight.
